title: CrowdStrike in talks to acquire Zscaler
summary: A combination would create one of the world's largest pure-play cybersecurity providers as enterprise customers seek to reduce the number of security vendors they use, favoring providers that can deliver multiple products through a single relationship.
llm_summary: CrowdStrike is reportedly negotiating to buy cloud‑security firm Zscaler, a move that would merge two of the biggest pure‑play cybersecurity companies. The combined entity would give enterprise customers a single vendor that can provide a broad suite of threat‑detection, endpoint‑protection and secure‑access services, aligning with the growing demand to simplify security stacks.
